ideas/testTime-and-lifethinking.title: LLM benefits from "test time scaling", how about us?
ideas/testTime-and-lifethinking.content:
This weekend, I listened to an interview video from bilibili. It is about two phd graduates talking about whether you should pursue a phd degree or a tenured position.
I strongly agree with the idea of the 2nd speaker, that “If you treat life like a race and try your best to go to the destination, then what? Your life will be continued. When making your important life decisions, don’t think this decision will change your life, you own your life, and you can change it. What truly matters is not the decision itself but the specific daily life that follows it”
I think this idea is similar to the “test time scaling” idea in LLM, which if you spend more time and resources making a decision, you will gain many unique experience and knowledge. Whether them 100% useful or not, but they will help you make better decisions in the future.

index.title: Welcome!
index.content:
I’m Fengjie Li (you can call me FFengJay as well). This is my personal wiki that I use to organize my notes, ideas and thoughts.
About Research
I’m a PostGraduate Student in Computer Science at Tianjin University, China. I’m exploring the program analysis, program repair, program synthesis. Recently, I’m have finished serveral works about combining large language models and program repair. You can find my works in my google scholar page, feel free to contact me if you have any questions.
About Reading
I’m insterested in reading philosophy, history and psychology. I’m reading books about Camus and Hesse and history about Ming dynasty. I’ll share my reading notes here in the future.
About Life
I am in my twenties now, and my life philosophy is “go with the flow”. I’m enjoying every moment of my life, I hope you enjoy your life too.
Thanks of your time :)
